h1.en: 56 kW stays on the Diesel 30 vs Diesel 40 Concrete Pump page
h1.zh: 56 kW仍写在柴油30和柴油40混凝土泵有何不同这一页

directAnswer.en: Diesel 30 and Diesel 40 are concrete pumps from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. Diesel 30 lists 4105 / 56 kW, 15 m³/h, 20 MPa, distance 60 m / 180 m and aggregate 3 cm and below. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Internal_combustion_engine.
directAnswer.zh: 柴油30和柴油40是河北品锦机械在邢台的混凝土泵。柴油30标出 4105 / 56 kW、15 m³/h、20 MPa、距离 60 m / 180 m、骨料 3 cm 及以下。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Internal_combustion_engine。

body.en: Downloaded from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Internal_combustion_engine. The image subject is Four stroke engine diagram. Diesel 30 and Diesel 40 are concrete pumps from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. Diesel engine power: Diesel 30 lists 4105 / 56 kW. Diesel 40 lists 4108 / 66 kW. Pumping distance (H / V): Diesel 30 lists 60 m / 180 m. Diesel 40 lists 120 m / 360 m. Diesel 30 lists entries that Diesel 40 does not: Max. aggregate size 3 cm and below. Open /en/products/diesel-30-concrete-pump/ for Diesel 30 and /en/products/diesel-40-concrete-pump/ for Diesel 40.
body.zh: 此图下载自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Internal_combustion_engine。画面内容是Four stroke engine diagram。柴油30和柴油40是河北品锦机械在邢台的混凝土泵。理论输送量：柴油30标出 15 m³/h；柴油40标出 26 m³/h。外形尺寸：柴油30标出 4000 × 1500 × 1800 mm；柴油40标出 4200 × 1600 × 1800 mm。下一个柴油编号对应另一套发动机代号，不是同一行的小改动。

body.en: Diesel 30 lists 4105 / 56 kW, 15 m³/h, 20 MPa, distance 60 m / 180 m and aggregate 3 cm and below. Theoretical output: Diesel 30 lists 15 m³/h. Diesel 40 lists 26 m³/h. Dimensions: Diesel 30 lists 4000 × 1500 × 1800 mm. Diesel 40 lists 4200 × 1600 × 1800 mm. Diesel 40 lists entries that Diesel 30 does not: Hydraulic pump Kawasaki 112. Hebei Pinjin Machinery builds these concrete pumps in Xingtai, Hebei.
body.zh: 柴油30标出 4105 / 56 kW、15 m³/h、20 MPa、距离 60 m / 180 m、骨料 3 cm 及以下。最大出口压力：柴油30标出 20 MPa；柴油40标出 25 MPa。以上是河北品锦机械在邢台混凝土泵页面上写出的格子，不是把一台机器换算成另一台。看柴油30请打开 /zh/products/diesel-30-concrete-pump/，看柴油40请打开 /zh/products/diesel-40-concrete-pump/。

body.en: Diesel 40 lists 4108 / 66 kW, 26 m³/h, 25 MPa, distance 120 m / 360 m and a Kawasaki 112. Max. outlet pressure: Diesel 30 lists 20 MPa. Diesel 40 lists 25 MPa. These are shown entries on the Hebei Pinjin Machinery pages for concrete pumps made in Xingtai. A blank or missing label is not filled from the other concrete pump. The number in a commercial name is not a licence to copy output, pressure or distance.
body.zh: 柴油40标出 4108 / 66 kW、26 m³/h、25 MPa、距离 120 m / 360 m 和川崎112。料斗容积：柴油30标出 0.3 m³；柴油40标出 0.4 m³。柴油30有、柴油40没有的行：最大骨料粒径 3 cm and below。商品名里的数字不能用来抄产量、压力或距离。

body.en: Diesel 40's specification table does not list an aggregate row. Hopper capacity: Diesel 30 lists 0.3 m³. Diesel 40 lists 0.4 m³. They are not a calculated conversion from one model to the other. The next diesel numeral is a different engine code, not a small edit to the same row. If a job needs a figure this pair does not list, use the contact page rather than inventing a bore, stroke or price.
body.zh: 柴油机功率：柴油30标出 4105 / 56 kW；柴油40标出 4108 / 66 kW。输送距离（水平/垂直）：柴油30标出 60 m / 180 m；柴油40标出 120 m / 360 m。柴油40有、柴油30没有的行：液压泵 Kawasaki 112。如果工况需要这对机型没有写出的数字，请走联系页，不要编造缸径、行程或价格。

question.en: Does Diesel 30 list the same diesel engine power as Diesel 40?
question.zh: 柴油30和柴油40的柴油机功率一样吗？

answer.en: No. Diesel 30 lists 4105 / 56 kW. Diesel 40 lists 4108 / 66 kW. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue entries from Xingtai, and neither entry replaces the other. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Internal_combustion_engine.
answer.zh: 不一样。柴油30标出 4105 / 56 kW。柴油40标出 4108 / 66 kW。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Internal_combustion_engine画面里印出的数字。

question.en: Does Diesel 30 list the same theoretical output as Diesel 40?
question.zh: 柴油30和柴油40的理论输送量一样吗？

answer.en: No. Diesel 30 lists 15 m³/h. Diesel 40 lists 26 m³/h. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue entries from Xingtai, and neither entry replaces the other. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Internal_combustion_engine.
answer.zh: 不一样。柴油30标出 15 m³/h。柴油40标出 26 m³/h。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Internal_combustion_engine画面里印出的数字。

question.en: Does Diesel 30 list the same max. outlet pressure as Diesel 40?
question.zh: 柴油30和柴油40的最大出口压力一样吗？

answer.en: No. Diesel 30 lists 20 MPa. Diesel 40 lists 25 MPa. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue entries from Xingtai, and neither entry replaces the other. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Internal_combustion_engine.
answer.zh: 不一样。柴油30标出 20 MPa。柴油40标出 25 MPa。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Internal_combustion_engine画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: Why is max. aggregate size missing on Diesel 40?
question.zh: 为什么柴油40没有最大骨料粒径？

answer.en: The Diesel 40 page does not list that label. Diesel 30 lists 3 cm and below. Leave the missing entry blank. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not publish a rule for copying it across concrete pumps. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Internal_combustion_engine.
answer.zh: 柴油40这一页没有标出这个标题。柴油30标出的是 3 cm and below。缺的格子保持空白。河北品锦机械没有公布把该格抄到另一台混凝土泵上的规则。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Internal_combustion_engine画面里印出的数字。
